purpose: Define what counts as a high-quality AI/Semis analyst workpaper before source-route/parser engineering starts.

core_questions.question: Is AI capex a real demand pool, pull-forward, or market narrative?
core_questions.minimum_answer: Separate cloud/hyperscaler capex as demand-pool evidence from supplier allocation evidence.

core_questions.question: How do accelerator architecture, memory, interconnect, software ecosystem, power and supply bottlenecks affect product competitiveness?
core_questions.minimum_answer: Compare NVDA Blackwell/GB200, AMD MI300/MI35x and Google TPU as product capability and substitution routes, without requiring SKU revenue.

core_questions.question: Who deploys or configures the products, and is the deployment official, proxy, or inferred?
core_questions.minimum_answer: Distinguish official OEM/cloud/customer deployment from generic demand proxy.

core_questions.question: Does AI server demand improve Dell's profit quality, or only revenue visibility?
core_questions.minimum_answer: Bridge orders/backlog to shipments, ISG revenue, gross/operating margin, GPU pass-through cost, attach rate, working capital and cash conversion.

core_questions.question: How does AI demand read through to TSMC, HBM/CoWoS, ASML, AMAT, LRCX and KLAC?
core_questions.minimum_answer: Separate foundry, packaging, memory/HBM, lithography, deposition/etch and process-control mechanisms.

core_questions.question: Is the business improvement already priced in?
core_questions.minimum_answer: Require valuation, ownership, short/options/positioning, sector reaction and capital-feedback evidence before making price-in claims.

core_questions.question: What would break or weaken the thesis?
core_questions.minimum_answer: Cover capex digestion, server-OEM margin dilution, substitution, supply bottlenecks, export controls, customer concentration and extreme price-in.

good_answer_requirements: Open with a bounded analyst judgment, not a source list.
Explain the business mechanism from demand pool to product to deployment to financial quality to market expectation.
Use product/spec/deployment evidence for product capability even when SKU revenue is absent.
Never turn capex demand pool into supplier allocation without deployment/order/backlog/financial bridge.
Separate strong evidence, medium evidence, proxy evidence and typed gaps.
State what cannot be inferred from every proxy or relationship edge.
Include counter-thesis and what-would-change in the body of the workpaper.
bad_answer_patterns: AI capex is high, therefore every AI infrastructure supplier benefits.
No SKU revenue is available, therefore the product layer cannot be judged.
Relationship graph edges are used as direct financial facts.
Dell AI server orders are treated as proof of high-margin growth without margin bridge.
Semicap peers are grouped together without bookings/backlog, WFE, EUV/DUV, memory/foundry/logic or export-control mechanism.
Market price-in is discussed without valuation, ownership, positioning, event or capital-feedback evidence.
Parser or locator gaps are reported as public-source absence.

research_quality_pass_requires: all required judgment chains are answered or typed as partially_answered_with_boundary/parser_gap/source_absent_after_attempt/commercial_gap
at least one product/customer/supply-chain/financial bridge is explicit
writer-ready material can support a bounded analyst view
engineering_pass_is_insufficient_when: promoted rows exist but cannot answer a judgment chain
slot coverage exists but every slot is proxy-only
exact financial rows exist but product/architecture/customer deployment is absent
product rows exist but financial bridge is absent
